name: Exact characteristic-zero preconditioner tightening of the full N=1 finite inverse radius

statement.note_ascii: the actual integer-scaled characteristic-zero 49x49 N=1 observability Jacobian is reconstructed and inverted exactly over Q; its infinity inverse norm lies between 1.28 and 1.29, replacing determinant-only Cramer/Hadamard preconditioning by A=J0^{-1}

definitions.J_0: selected 49x49 C^n n!-scaled shell-energy Taylor-jet Jacobian at the deterministic small-integer N=1 center on the certified translation-transverse slice
definitions.H_j: certified finite Hessian-row l1 majorant for selected observation j on the declared enclosing box
definitions.r: strictly positive finite infinity-norm local-state radius with preconditioned defect at most one half

parents.evidence: the same 49-dimensional translation-transverse shell-energy chart is reconstructed over characteristic zero
A=J0^-1 makes the center defect exactly zero and the finite Hessian enclosure controls the neighborhood defect
the preceding row-aware Cramer/Hadamard radius is replaced by the actual exact rational inverse of the selected center Jacobian
the certified radius improves from the 10^-3878 scale to between 10^-59 and 10^-58, but remains far below practical measurement scale

claim_boundary: Fixed finite N=1 local result only. The exact inverse removes determinant-bound slack but still uses conservative finite Hessian majorants. It is not a practical sensor tolerance, does not certify robust branch capture or arbitrary-N inversion, and has no continuum-regularity, singularity, or Clay implication.
